verdict.rationale: Railway documents an official CLI for deploying from the terminal and an MCP server that lets AI assistants create projects, manage environments and redeploy services, so it can be scripted without the dashboard. Nothing in the evidence shows CI-specific use: no project or API tokens for non-interactive auth, no headless flags, and no CI pipeline integration. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD usage (e.g., GitHub Actions), token-based non-interactive authentication, explicit headless/non-interactive CLI mode, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI.
It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services.
